description: This file defines styles for buttons in a CSS preprocessor language (SCSS/SASS), including base styles, variants, link buttons, and size modifications, with parameterization and includes for reusable mixins.

classes.name: btn
classes.description: Base style for buttons, including layout, typography, borders, and interactive states with hover, focus, active, and disabled variants.

classes.name: btn-variant-loops
classes.description: Iterates over theme colors to create color-specific button styles, including shades and tints for different variants.

classes.name: btn-link
classes.description: Styles a button to behave and look like a hyperlink, with specific text and hover styles.

classes.name: btn-lg
classes.description: Large button size with increased padding and font size.

classes.name: btn-sm
classes.description: Small button size with decreased padding and font size.

methods.name: button-variant
methods.description: Mixin to create button variants with specific background, border, hover, and active styles.

methods.name: button-outline-variant
methods.description: Mixin to create outline style variants for buttons.

methods.name: button-size
methods.description: Mixin to set button size parameters such as padding, font size, and border radius.

methods.name: shade-color
methods.description: Function to produce a darker variant of a color.

methods.name: tint-color
methods.description: Function to produce a lighter variant of a color.
